annotations.text:
A · Dark console
OLED black, one cyan accent, mono labels. Feels like a hardware remote; easy on the eyes in a dark room. Tradeoff: can look 'techy' / less friendly.

B · Soft tactile
Warm off-white, pill buttons with soft shadows, orange accent. Friendly, consumer-app feel; reads well in daylight. Tradeoff: bright screen when used in the dark next to a TV.

C · Editorial
Black & white, serif headings, hairline rules, no cards. Distinctive and calm. Tradeoff: fewer visual affordances — buttons read as text, needs care for touch targets.
